Here is a snapshot of our technology stack:\n\n - Core Backend: We power our services using PHP, Node.js (TypeScript), and Golang. We are also embracing Serverless architecture, leveraging it specifically for our newest modules and features to ensure maximum scalability and speed of innovation.\n\n - Frontend Ecosystem: Angular is our main framework for web applications, though some of our cross-functional teams build components using React.\n\n - Mobile Development: We deliver high-quality cross-platform mobile experiences powered entirely by React Native.\n\n - Cloud & DevOps: Our entire infrastructure is fully cloud-native and hosted on AWS.\n\n \n\n\n🛠️ THE DAY-TO-DAY\n\n - Engineer Excellence: Design, implement, and deploy scalable software solutions that enhance the core functionality of our global SaaS platform.\n\n - Collaborate Without Borders: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX designers, and QA legends to turn visionary concepts into high-performing features.\n\n - Champion Code Quality: Write clean, efficient, and beautifully documented code while participating in peer reviews to keep our standards sky-high.\n\n - Crush Technical Debt: Proactively engage in refactoring efforts to boost system performance and ensure our codebase remains maintainable and modern.\n\n - Solve Complex Puzzles: Monitor and troubleshoot live applications, identifying and resolving issues quickly to ensure our users always have a smooth experience.\n\n - Live the Agile Life: Fully immerse yourself in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to keep our momentum and goals perfectly aligned.\n\n\n\n\n💪 YOUR SUPERPOWERS\n\n - Experience: 4 + years of experience in full-stack development\n\n - Technical Versatility: You bring proficiency in NodeJS. Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. \n\nAt Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.\n\n\n\nTHE ADVENTURE AHEAD 🚀\n\nStep into a high-impact, hands-on role as our Enablement Lead, Business Development, where you will be the dedicated strategic partner responsible for elevating the performance and productivity of our global BDR and SDR teams! You will own the full enablement lifecycle, transforming how we onboard, train, and develop top-tier sales talent from day one through continuous content mastery. Sitting at the exciting intersection of Marketing, Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations, you will build the foundational skills our reps need to dominate the market. Get ready to empower our team to hit their targets faster and drive our go-to-market strategy to new, thrilling heights!\n\n\n\nTHE DAY-TO-DAY 🗓️\n\n - Architect the Future: Design, own, and execute a best-in-class 30/60/90-day onboarding program that quickly accelerates new BDRs to full productivity.\n\n - Command the Classroom: Conduct engaging, hands-on training sessions covering cold calling, prospecting strategies, objection handling, discovery techniques, and mastery of our tech stack (including Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Navigator).\n\n - Drive the Coaching Culture: Partner with BDR Leadership and Subject Matter Experts to identify skill gaps, facilitating targeted workshops and coaching sessions that drive continuous performance improvement.\n\n - Curate the Arsenal: Organize and maintain a centralized content repository packed with tailored sales playbooks, scripts, email templates, and battle cards to meet the BDR team’s exact needs.\n\n - Bridge the Gap: Collaborate with Product Marketing to seamlessly translate technical product releases, competitive intelligence, and marketing initiatives into easy-to-digest, actionable sales content.\n\n - Measure the Magic: Establish clear enablement success metrics (like ramp time, conversion rates, and content usage) and analyze performance data in partnership with Revenue Operations to prove program impact and guide future investments.\n\n - Champion Readiness: Administer the BDR certification program, ensuring consistent skill application before reps are eligible for promotion.\n\n\n\nYOUR SUPERPOWERS 🦸‍♀️\n\n - Enablement Expert: You bring 3+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, or a similar training and development role, with a strong, dedicated focus on the Business Development/SDR function.\n\n - Former Sales Star: You possess a proven track record of success as a top-performing BDR or Junior Account Executive earlier in your career.\n\n - Prospecting Pro: You have a deep understanding of the BDR motion, modern prospecting techniques, and the absolute best practices for high-velocity pipeline generation.\n\n - Captivating Communicator: You showcase exceptional presentation, facilitation, and public speaking skills, with the undeniable ability to command a room (whether virtual or in-person).\n\n - Tech Stack Savvy: You boast strong, hands-on experience with modern sales engagement platforms and CRM systems, with a strong preference for Salesforce.\n\n - Project Mastermind: You leverage stellar project management and organizational skills to flawlessly manage multiple large-scale projects simultaneously.\n\n\n\n\nOUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝\n\nGreat work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.\n\n\n\n\nOUR TOTAL REWARDS PHILOSOPHY 🎉\n\nOur Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:\n\n - Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.\n\n - Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.\n\n - Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.\n   \n\n\n\n\nOUR PROMISE TO YOU 😍\n\n - Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.\n\n - Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.\n\n - Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!\n\n - Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!\n\n - Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.\n\n\n\n\nABOUT DOCEBO 💙\n\nAt Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. Working closely with Cloud Infrastructure &amp; Operations, Engineering, and other security teams, this role is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving cloud security controls across all layers of the stack — from infrastructure provisioning and container orchestration to runtime detection and compliance enforcement. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in terms of risk and moves quickly to reduce it. The role also includes participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents affecting Docebo systems.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>Responsibilities (including but not limited to):</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cloud Security Architecture &amp; Hardening:</strong> Own the security posture of Docebo's AWS environments. Evaluate and improve network segmentation, IAM boundaries, and data protection controls. Identify and remediate misconfigurations using CSPM tooling and manual review.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Infrastructure as Code Security: </strong>Partner with Cloud Infrastructure to integrate security controls into IaC workflows. Define guardrails to catch insecure configurations before deployment. Own security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and promote a shift-left approach to cloud security across engineering teams.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Incident Response &amp; On-Call: </strong>Participate in the on-call rotation for security incidents, including triage, containment, and escalation for after-hours events. Lead investigation and root cause analysis for cloud security incidents with clear written post-mortems. Leverage automation and AI tooling to reduce mean time to detect and respond.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cloud Detection &amp; Threat Monitoring:</strong> Build and maintain detection coverage for cloud-native threats (privilege escalation, unusual API activity, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and more). Working closely with Cloud Infrastructure & Operations, Engineering, and other security teams, this role is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving cloud security controls across all layers of the stack — from infrastructure provisioning and container orchestration to runtime detection and compliance enforcement. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in terms of risk and moves quickly to reduce it. The role also includes participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents affecting Docebo systems.\n\n\n\n\nRESPONSIBILITIES (INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO):\n\n - Cloud Security Architecture & Hardening: Own the security posture of Docebo's AWS environments. Define and enforce secure account structures, service control policies (SCPs), guardrails, and baseline configurations across multi-account setups. Evaluate and improve network segmentation, IAM boundaries, and data protection controls. Identify and remediate misconfigurations using CSPM tooling and manual review.\n\n - Infrastructure as Code Security: Partner with Cloud Infrastructure to integrate security controls into IaC workflows. Define guardrails to catch insecure configurations before deployment. Own security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and promote a shift-left approach to cloud security across engineering teams.\n\n - Incident Response & On-Call: Participate in the on-call rotation for security incidents, including triage, containment, and escalation for after-hours events. Lead investigation and root cause analysis for cloud security incidents with clear written post-mortems. Leverage automation and AI tooling to reduce mean time to detect and respond.\n\n - Cloud Detection & Threat Monitoring: Build and maintain detection coverage for cloud-native threats (privilege escalation, unusual API activity, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and more). Leverage CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SIEM integrations to maintain visibility across the AWS estate. Align detection logic with MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.\n\n - Vulnerability & Configuration Management: Own vulnerability management for cloud workloads — prioritizing findings from cloud configuration assessments, and runtime protection tools. Drive remediation with Engineering and Infrastructure teams, and build automated enforcement where manual review doesn't scale.\n\n - Identity & Access Management: Define and enforce least-privilege principles across AWS IAM, service accounts, and federated identity. Review and improve IAM policies, permission boundaries, cross-account roles, and access patterns. Reduce standing access and enforce JIT access where appropriate.\n\n - Development of Security Best Practices: Develop and document best practices, policies, and procedures for cloud security. Provide guidance and training to engineering and infrastructure teams to promote a security-aware culture.\n\n - Vendor relationships: Maintain relationships with security vendors for technical issues, ensure smooth operations of security tools and services, and escalate problems or incidents to vendors when required.\n   \n   \n\n\nWHAT IT TAKES TO BE SUCCESSFUL:\n\nYou're a cloud security practitioner who operates with a builder's mindset. You understand AWS deeply — not just its security services, but how misconfigurations and design decisions create real risk. You're comfortable reading IaC, reviewing IAM policies, and diving into CloudTrail logs to reconstruct what happened. You know how to work with engineering and infrastructure teams as a partner, not a gatekeeper — and you can communicate risk clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the cloud console. You're comfortable being on-call and making decisions under pressure.\n\n\n\nAdditionally, holding security-related certifications such as those from ISC2, ISACA, SANS, or CompTIA, and having Cloud Architecture certifications (AWS Security Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent) will significantly enhance your effectiveness in this role.\n\n\n\nWe know great candidates don't always check every box. Deep hands-on experience with AWS security services: IAM, SCPs, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config, KMS, VPC security, and more.\n\n - Good knowledge of Kubernetes security — including RBAC, pod security standards, network policies, admission controllers, and secrets management.\n\n - Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) and cloud workload protection (CWPP/CNAPP) tools.\n\n - Experience securing IaC pipelines (Terraform, CloudFormation) and integrating security scanning into CI/CD workflows.\n\n - Good experience with container and image security — scanning, runtime protection, supply chain risk.\n\n - Experience with SIEM and detection engineering — building and tuning cloud-native detection rules, threat hunting across CloudTrail and application logs.\n\n - Familiarity with automation platforms and AI-driven security tools to streamline detection, enrichment, and response.\n\n - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and scripting (Python, Bash, or similar) to develop custom security tooling and automate workflows.\n\n - Strong IAM fundamentals: least privilege, cross-account roles, permission boundaries, federated identity, and privileged access management.\n\n - Comfortable working across Azure/GCP in addition to AWS — multi-cloud exposure is a plus.\n\n - Actual Impact.\n\nAt Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.\n\n\n\n\nWe’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.\n\n\n\n\nSo… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.\n\n\n\n\nTHE ADVENTURE AHEAD 🚀\n\nAs our Product Designer for Content Experience, you will step onto a global stage to design the intuitive, AI-assisted workflows that power how the world's leading organizations create, manage, and discover learning content at scale. You won't just be tweaking interfaces; you will actively turn complex content operations into beautifully seamless, high-impact product experiences that make workplace learning feel like magic. Operating at the sweet spot of advanced interaction design and cutting-edge AI technology, your work will directly elevate how millions of learners build skills and grow their careers every single day.\n\n\n\n\nTHE DAY-TO-DAY 💻\n\n - Lead the Charge: Drive the end-to-end design for key Content product features and complex workflows, transforming them from messy problem spaces into polished, shipped realities.\n\n - Architect the Flow: Map out intricate content structures, intuitive screen transitions, and detailed product states so that content creators, reviewers, and learners always know exactly what to do next.\n\n - Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to navigate technical constraints, align on scope, and balance design ambition with real-world implementation.\n\n - Design the AI Frontier: Craft seamless, human-in-the-loop AI workflows that empower users to generate, refine, and govern content while remaining confidently in control.\n\n - Polish to Perfection: Prototype realistic feature states and design complete edge-case experiences—from empty states and localization needs to recovery paths—ensuring high quality before a single line of code is written.\n\n - Shape the Language: Elevate our product vocabulary by designing clear labels, helper text, and feedback messaging that guide users through complex content operations effortlessly.\n   \n   \n\n\nYOUR SUPERPOWERS 🦸‍♀️\n\n - SaaS Wizardry: Bring a proven track record of designing high-complexity B2B SaaS, enterprise content platforms, authoring systems, or AI-assisted products.\n\n - Systems Thinking: Showcase a stunning portfolio packed with complete feature flows, robust information architecture, and beautiful, implementation-ready interaction design.\n\n - Ambiguity Navigator: Demonstrate the confidence to dive into loosely defined product problems, make tradeoffs visible, and proactively pull in partners when scope expands.\n\n - State Master: Possess a meticulous eye for the details, skillfully designing for multiple user roles, permissions, error recovery, and accessible design system patterns.\n\n - Collaborative Catalyst: Excel in a highly cross-functional environment, utilizing strong communication skills to explain the \"why\" behind your design decisions through the lens of user value and business impact.\n\n - AI Curiosity: Bring a visible learning mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate research, explore concepts, and sharpen your own design craft.\n   \n   \n\n\nBONUS POINTS 🌟\n\n - Domain Expertise: Prior experience designing enterprise LMS tools, digital asset management (DAM), multimedia content creation workflows, or HR tech.\n\n - AI Trailblazer: Past hands-on experience designing generated-output, content recommendation, or complex review and approval cycles.\n\n - Design System Champion: A history of actively contributing to shared design systems, accessibility standards, or localized content patterns.\n   \n   \n\n\nOUR INTERVIEW PROCESS 🗺️\n\n - We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.\n\n\n\n\nWe’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.\n\n\n\n\nSo… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.\n\n\n\n\n🚀 THE ADVENTURE AHEAD\n\nReady to launch your cloud engineering journey by helping power the future of enterprise learning? As a Cloud Engineer I at Docebo, you won’t just keep systems running—you'll collaborate with seasoned mentors to automate, secure, and scale our multi-tenant AWS cloud environments. You will play a vital role in keeping our platforms robust, compliant, and rock-solid for millions of users worldwide. If you're eager to turn complex infrastructure challenges into seamless, high-impact performance, your next big adventure starts here!\n\n\n\n\n🛠️ THE DAY-TO-DAY\n\n - Build the Foundation: Implement defined AWS compute, storage, networking, and IAM changes alongside senior engineers using best-in-class multi-tenant patterns.\n\n - Automate Everything: Craft and refine Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) modules and scripts to streamline routine provisioning, maintenance, and backups.\n\n - Master Observability: Configure dynamic dashboards and alerts in tools like Datadog and CloudWatch to keep a proactive finger on overall system health.\n\n - Troubleshoot & Resolve: Dive into non-production environments to investigate issues, analyze logs and metrics, apply targeted fixes, and escalate complex puzzles when needed.\n\n - Drive Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate closely with Product Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to translate requirements into smooth cloud changes.\n\n - Guard the Castle: Support critical FedRAMP system patching routines, monitor security compliance dashboards, and take swift action to resolve vulnerabilities.\n\n - Document for Success: Create clear runbooks, configuration updates, and script documentation so the entire team can easily reuse and build upon your work.\n\n\n⚡ YOUR SUPERPOWERS\n\n - Solid Educational Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on project experience.\n\n - Early Cloud Craft: 1–2 years of experience or project work in cloud or infrastructure engineering, with exposure to AWS (or another major cloud provider).\n\n - Tooling & Scripting Chops: Comfort navigating Linux, writing scripts in Bash or Python, and managing code using Git alongside CI/CD tools like GitLab CI or Jenkins.\n\n - Incurable Curiosity: A high interest in modern containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.\n\n - Growth Mindset: A strong problem-solving approach paired with an enthusiastic drive to continually elevate your cloud engineering skills.\n\n\n\n\nOUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝\n\nGreat work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Actual Impact.\n\nAt Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.\n\n\n\n\nWe’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.\n\n\n\n\nSo… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.\n\n\n\n\nROLE OVERVIEW\n\nWe are looking for an Accounts Receivable Specialist to join Docebo's Finance team, supporting the Senior Credit Manager in Italy.\n\nIn particular, the finance specialist will provide financial, clerical, and data analysis, while managing the entire invoicing process flow using Suite billing and accounting system to ensure efficiency and accuracy in customer accounts and billing. The ideal candidate will thrive on the blend of autonomy and teamwork while helping build out the best practices for this new role but also be focused on meeting tight deadlines for Docebo statutory accounts and audits.\n\nThis is a global role and will manage the AR processes mainly focused on the EMEA region.\n\n\n\n\n\nTHE DAY-TO-DAY\n\n - Prepare and manage analysis on Accounts Receivable (AR) accounts, as required.\n\n - Check and release invoices through NetSuite Suite Billing.\n\n - Manage and resolve revenue issues dealing with the Sales Team.\n\n - Manage Cash application, GL accounts reconciliation of receivables, including AR aging, bad debt exposure.\n\n - Support the monthly closing and quarterly activities related to Receivables, coordinating with the Local Financial accountant.\n\n - Support the team with Cash Flow activities (Actual/Forecast).\n\n - Handle customers' cash receipts application and DSO.\n\n - Assist auditors with their requests and questions quarterly, at mid-year, and end of year.\n\n - Assist any other areas of the Financial Accounting Department as necessary.\n\n - Contribute to Treasury functions, record customer and third-party payments, and support the team with Cash Flow activities (Actual/Forecast).\n   \n   \n   \n\n\nREQUIREMENTS\n\n - Bachelor's degree in Accounting.\n\n - English as a 2nd language (B2/C1 level).\n\n - Good knowledge of Accounting and accounting principles.\n\n - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Package / G-suite.\n\n - Team Working and communication strengths.\n\n - Strong analytical skills.\n\n - Ability to be proactive and work autonomously.\n   \n   \n   \n\n\nBONUS POINTS\n\n - Previous experience at least 2-3 years in Receivables/ General Ledger department in a Multinational company, preferably in the software industry.\n\n - This role focuses on inspiring and educating prospective customers about Docebo’s learning platform, orchestrating complex sales cycles with C-level stakeholders, and driving predictable, sustainable revenue growth. The Senior Enterprise AE brings strong territory discipline, outstanding executive presence, and a proven ability to prioritize, penetrate, and win in large, multi-stakeholder accounts.</p><div style=\"min-height:1.2em;margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0\"> </div><h2>⚡ The Day-to-Day</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The responsibilities listed in this section are representative and not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed.</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Own a Named Enterprise Territory:</strong> Build and execute a territory plan for a defined list of named enterprise accounts across North America, with clear focus on whitespace, prioritization, and multi-threaded engagement.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Drive Net-New Revenue:</strong> Prospect, qualify, and close new business opportunities; this role is <strong>100% new logo acquisition</strong> (no ongoing account management book of business).</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Strategic Account Planning:</strong> Develop detailed account plans for top targets, including stakeholder maps, opportunity hypotheses, competitive positioning, and sequenced engagement strategies.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Lead Complex Sales Cycles:</strong> Orchestrate end-to-end enterprise sales motions from first conversation through signature, including discovery, business case development, evaluation management, and commercial negotiation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Engage Senior Stakeholders:</strong> Build trusted relationships with senior business and IT leaders (including HR, L&amp;D, CIO, CTO, and other C-level executives), positioning Docebo as a strategic partner in learning transformation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Articulate Value &amp; ROI:</strong> Collaborate with value engineering and solutions resources to quantify business outcomes, deliver compelling ROI analyses, and tie Docebo’s capabilities to critical customer initiatives.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Partner Cross-Functionally:</strong> Coordinate with Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Product to align on account strategy and ensure a frictionless customer buying experience.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Forecast with Discipline:</strong> Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in Salesforce, providing clear visibility into territory health, deal stages, risks, and forecast commitments.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Leverage Data &amp; Tools:</strong> Use CRM, sales engagement platforms, and market insights to prioritize efforts, refine territory strategy, and continuously improve win rates and cycle times.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Champion Docebo in the Market:</strong> Represent Docebo at industry events, webinars, and customer meetings as a credible thought partner on learning, HR-tech, and AI in the enterprise.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Coach &amp; Collaborate with BDRs:</strong> Partner with Business Development to focus outbound efforts on the right accounts, refine messaging, and improve meeting quality and pipeline generation.</p></li></ul><h2>🧠 Your Superpowers</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">To thrive as a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you bring a <strong>hunter mindset</strong> and a disciplined approach to managing a large, complex territory of named enterprise accounts. You are curious about learning technology and HR-tech trends, comfortable navigating both business and technical conversations, and skilled at translating customer challenges into clear, compelling Docebo solutions. You prioritize ruthlessly, focus your time where it matters most, and manage multiple strategic pursuits in parallel without losing attention to detail.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You are coachable, accountable, and resilient, with a consistent track record of meeting and exceeding quota in new business roles. You collaborate naturally with internal teams, communicate clearly, and are confident operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where expectations are high and the bar for execution is even higher.</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Experience:</strong> 8-10 years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, with at least 5 years focused on enterprise new business (hunter) roles.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Enterprise Selling:</strong> Demonstrated success closing large, multi-stakeholder, multi-year SaaS deals in complex organizations (typically 5,000+ employees) within North America.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Territory &amp; This role focuses on inspiring and educating prospective customers about Docebo’s learning platform, orchestrating complex sales cycles with C-level stakeholders, and driving predictable, sustainable revenue growth. The Senior Enterprise AE brings strong territory discipline, outstanding executive presence, and a proven ability to prioritize, penetrate, and win in large, multi-stakeholder accounts.\n\n \n\n\n⚡ THE DAY-TO-DAY\n\nThe responsibilities listed in this section are representative and not exhaustive. Drive Net-New Revenue: Prospect, qualify, and close new business opportunities; this role is 100% new logo acquisition (no ongoing account management book of business).\n\n - Strategic Account Planning: Develop detailed account plans for top targets, including stakeholder maps, opportunity hypotheses, competitive positioning, and sequenced engagement strategies.\n\n - Lead Complex Sales Cycles: Orchestrate end-to-end enterprise sales motions from first conversation through signature, including discovery, business case development, evaluation management, and commercial negotiation.\n\n - Engage Senior Stakeholders: Build trusted relationships with senior business and IT leaders (including HR, L&D, CIO, CTO, and other C-level executives), positioning Docebo as a strategic partner in learning transformation.\n\n - Articulate Value & ROI: Collaborate with value engineering and solutions resources to quantify business outcomes, deliver compelling ROI analyses, and tie Docebo’s capabilities to critical customer initiatives.\n\n - Partner Cross-Functionally: Coordinate with Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Product to align on account strategy and ensure a frictionless customer buying experience.\n\n - Forecast with Discipline: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in Salesforce, providing clear visibility into territory health, deal stages, risks, and forecast commitments.\n\n - Leverage Data & Tools: Use CRM, sales engagement platforms, and market insights to prioritize efforts, refine territory strategy, and continuously improve win rates and cycle times.\n\n - Champion Docebo in the Market: Represent Docebo at industry events, webinars, and customer meetings as a credible thought partner on learning, HR-tech, and AI in the enterprise.\n\n - Coach & Collaborate with BDRs: Partner with Business Development to focus outbound efforts on the right accounts, refine messaging, and improve meeting quality and pipeline generation.\n\n\n🧠 YOUR SUPERPOWERS\n\nTo thrive as a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you bring a hunter mindset and a disciplined approach to managing a large, complex territory of named enterprise accounts. You are curious about learning technology and HR-tech trends, comfortable navigating both business and technical conversations, and skilled at translating customer challenges into clear, compelling Docebo solutions. You prioritize ruthlessly, focus your time where it matters most, and manage multiple strategic pursuits in parallel without losing attention to detail.\n\nYou are coachable, accountable, and resilient, with a consistent track record of meeting and exceeding quota in new business roles. You collaborate naturally with internal teams, communicate clearly, and are confident operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where expectations are high and the bar for execution is even higher.\n\n - Experience: 8-10 years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, with at least 5 years focused on enterprise new business (hunter) roles.\n\n - Enterprise Selling: Demonstrated success closing large, multi-stakeholder, multi-year SaaS deals in complex organizations (typically 5,000+ employees) within North America.\n\n - Territory & Account Management: Proven ability to build and execute territory and named account plans, prioritize opportunities, and consistently deliver against ambitious pipeline and revenue targets.\n\n - Domain Expertise (Preferred): Experience in HR-tech, LMS, or adjacent domains (e.g., HCM, talent, learning & development) and familiarity with modern learning and AI trends.\n\n - Tools & Process: Proficiency with Salesforce (or equivalent CRM), sales engagement tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach), and web conferencing platforms (e.g., Zoom).\n\n - Executive Storytelling: Strong executive presence and storytelling skills, comfortable presenting to C-suite\n\n - Deal Orchestration: Demonstrates excellent discovery, qualification, and negotiation capabilities to drive opportunities forward.\n\n - Precision & Discipline: Highly organized, with a strong focus on follow-through and exceptional attention to detail.\n\n - Adaptive Mindset: Collaborative, curious, and thrives in a dynamic, high-growth environment.\n\n - Willingness to Travel: Ready to hit the road up to ~30% across North America for high-stakes customer meetings, events, and internal alignment.\n\n\n\n\nOUR HYBRID WORK PHILOSOPHY 🤝\n\nGreat work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.<br /><br /></p><h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The Senior Security Engineer will play a central role in securing Docebo's cloud infrastructure, with a primary focus on AWS environments. Working closely with Cloud Infrastructure &amp; Operations, Engineering, and other security teams, this role is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving cloud security controls across all layers of the stack — from infrastructure provisioning and container orchestration to runtime detection and compliance enforcement. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in terms of risk and moves quickly to reduce it. The role also includes participation in an on-call rotation for security incidents affecting Docebo systems.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>Responsibilities (including but not limited to):</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cloud Security Architecture &amp; Hardening:</strong> Own the security posture of Docebo's AWS environments. Define and enforce secure account structures, service control policies (SCPs), guardrails, and baseline configurations across multi-account setups. Evaluate and improve network segmentation, IAM boundaries, and data protection controls. Identify and remediate misconfigurations using CSPM tooling and manual review.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Infrastructure as Code Security: </strong>Partner with Cloud Infrastructure to integrate security controls into IaC workflows. Define guardrails to catch insecure configurations before deployment. Own security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and promote a shift-left approach to cloud security across engineering teams.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Incident Response &amp; On-Call: </strong>Participate in the on-call rotation for security incidents, including triage, containment, and escalation for after-hours events. Lead investigation and root cause analysis for cloud security incidents with clear written post-mortems. Leverage automation and AI tooling to reduce mean time to detect and respond.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cloud Detection &amp; Threat Monitoring:</strong> Build and maintain detection coverage for cloud-native threats (privilege escalation, unusual API activity, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and more). Leverage CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SIEM integrations to maintain visibility across the AWS estate. Align detection logic with MITRE ATT&amp;CK for Cloud.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Vulnerability &amp; Configuration Management:</strong> Own vulnerability management for cloud workloads — prioritizing findings from cloud configuration assessments, and runtime protection tools. Drive remediation with Engineering and Infrastructure teams, and build automated enforcement where manual review doesn't scale.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Identity &amp; Access Management:</strong> Define and enforce least-privilege principles across AWS IAM, service accounts, and federated identity. Review and improve IAM policies, permission boundaries, cross-account roles, and access patterns. Reduce standing access and enforce JIT access where appropriate.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Development of Security Best Practices:</strong> Develop and document best practices, policies, and procedures for cloud security. Provide guidance and training to engineering and infrastructure teams to promote a security-aware culture.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Vendor relationships:</strong> Maintain relationships with security vendors for technical issues, ensure smooth operations of security tools and services, and escalate problems or incidents to vendors when required.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p></li></ul><h2><strong>What it takes to be successful</strong>:</h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're a cloud security practitioner who operates with a builder's mindset. You understand AWS deeply — not just its security services, but how misconfigurations and design decisions create real risk. You're comfortable reading IaC, reviewing IAM policies, and diving into CloudTrail logs to reconstruct what happened. You know how to work with engineering and infrastructure teams as a partner, not a gatekeeper — and you can communicate risk clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the cloud console. You're comfortable being on-call and making decisions under pressure.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Additionally, holding security-related certifications such as those from ISC2, ISACA, SANS, or CompTIA, and having Cloud Architecture certifications (AWS Security Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent) will significantly enhance your effectiveness in this role.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We know great candidates don't always check every box. If you're excited about this role but don't meet 100% of the qualifications listed, we still encourage you to apply — we'd love to hear from you.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>Requirements</strong>:</h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">5+ years of relevant work experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on cloud security in production AWS environments.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Deep hands-on experience with AWS security services: IAM, SCPs, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config, KMS, VPC security, and more.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Good knowledge of Kubernetes security — including RBAC, pod security standards, network policies, admission controllers, and secrets management.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) and cloud workload protection (CWPP/CNAPP) tools.</p></li><li><p Reduce standing access and enforce JIT access where appropriate.\n\n - Development of Security Best Practices: Develop and document best practices, policies, and procedures for cloud security.
